title: 대법관후보추천위원회 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Meetings)
(1) Where the Chairperson intends to convene a meeting, the Chairperson shall notify each member of the date and time, place, agenda items, etc. of the meeting at least three days before it is held. Provided, however, that this shall not apply in an emergency or where other unavoidable grounds exist.
(2) A meeting shall be opened with the attendance of a majority of the incumbent members.
(3) The Chief Justice of the Supreme Court may attend a meeting or express his or her opinions on the agenda item by another means.
(4) The procedures, contents, etc. of meetings shall not be disclosed.
